senses.def: Just be white (used sardonically to reflect the belief that white men are greatly advantaged over other men at attracting women)
ex: ‘JBW’ or ‘Just Be White’—the idea that being white automatically makes you more attractive, particularly to non- white women
In misogynist incel communities, the acronym “JBW” (Just Be White) is a popular expression of white men’s perceived sexual advantages.
